Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Yogesh Upadhyay, learned
counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Sandeep Sharma, learned AGA
for the State.
3. The applicant has sought
anticipatory bail in respect of First
Information Report No. 0201 of 2026
dated 06.08.2026 registered with police
station Kunda, District Udham Singh
Nagar under Sections 305 (a), 331(3),
351(3), and 352 of BNS, 2023.
4. It is contended by the learned
counsel for the applicant that first
information report has been lodged after
51 days of the alleged incident, no
recovery has been made from the
applicant and applicant has no criminal
history.
5. Counter affidavit has been filed.
Learned State counsel in the counter

UKHC010154882026
2026:UHC:9864
affidavit also stated that no concrete
evidence has been disclosed against the
applicant.
6. Learned State counsel submits that
name of applicant was taken by the co-accused Arman and Sajid, from whom
the recovery of stolen articles was made.
7. He further submits that the
investigation is still going on and the
charge-sheet has not yet been filed.
8. Having considered the rival
submission of the parties, this Court is
of the view, since the FIR is highly
belated and further no recovery has been
made from the applicant even on his
pointing out, therefore, this Court feels
that the applicant deserves anticipatory
bail. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail is
granted.
9. It is directed that in the event of
arrest of the applicant Kasim Ali, he
shall be released on anticipatory bail on
executing a personal bond of Rs.
30,000/ - and two reliable sureties, each
of the like amount, to the satisfaction of
the Arresting Officer, subject to the
following conditions: -
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the
Investigating Agency and he shall make
himself available for interrogation by a
police officer as and when required;
(ii) If the charge-sheet is filed, the
applicant shall attend the trial court
regularly and he shall not seek any
unnecessary adjournment;

UKHC010154882026
2026:UHC:9864
(iii) Applicant shall not directly or
indirectly make any inducement, threat
or promise to any person, acquainted
with the facts of this case;
(iv) Applicant shall not leave the country
without the previous permission of the
trial court.
10. It is clarified that if the applicant
misuses or violates any of the
conditions, imposed upon him, the
prosecution agency will be free to move
the Court for cancellation of the
anticipatory bail.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 29.10.2026
Nahid
